contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		currentSale: Sale = self.CurrentSale,
		currentStore: Store = self.CurrentStore
	precondition:
		currentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		currentStore.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Sale.allInstances()->includes(currentSale) and
		currentSale.IsComplete = false and
		currentSale.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=currentSale.Amount
	postcondition:
		let cashPayment: CashPayment in
		cashPayment.oclIsNew() and
		CashPayment.allInstances()->includes(cashPayment) and
		cashPayment.AmountTendered = amount and
		cashPayment.Balance = amount-currentSale.Amount and
		cashPayment.BelongedSale = currentSale and
		currentSale.AssoicatedPayment = cashPayment and
		currentSale.Belongedstore = currentStore and
		currentStore.Sales->includes(currentSale) and
		currentSale.Time = Now and
		currentSale.IsComplete = true and
		result = true
}
